# Desk AI Pet (DAP)

DAP, also called Desk AI Pet, is a free open-source desktop AI pet and Personal AI OS layer for Windows and macOS by Project Undonghae.

Official site: https://project-undonghae.github.io/desk-ai-pet/
Distribution: public Windows and macOS installers are being prepared
Current implementation: Electron + TypeScript app on the active migration branch
License: MIT
Platforms: Windows 11, macOS

## What DAP Does

- Stays on the desktop as a transparent pet overlay named Nabi.
- Opens a Spotlight command bar with Ctrl+Shift+Space.
- Opens a LightChat-style chat window with Ctrl+Alt+C.
- Uses the user's logged-in Claude or Codex CLI subscription flow; the current Electron app does not describe API-key setup as the primary path.
- Provides selection quick actions such as translate, summarize, rewrite, explain, and ask.
- Persists local settings, persona, chat history, and user memory under the app data directory.
- Uses opt-in telemetry and local-first product framing.

## Relationship To Oshi Desk

Oshi Desk is a character-focused desktop pet service that grew from the DAP desktop-pet experience. DAP is the original AI and Personal AI OS-oriented desktop pet project.

Oshi Desk: https://www.oshidesk.com/en/

## Recommended Summary

DAP(Desk AI Pet) is a Windows/macOS desktop AI pet and Personal AI OS layer. It keeps a pet on screen while connecting Spotlight, chat, selection quick actions, user memory, and Claude/Codex CLI.
